role: caller-driven monotonic supervision of offline optical-depth odometry; temporal freshness is not accuracy or permission to drive
clock: explicit caller now and acquisition timestamp in same monotonic epoch; no wall clock or threads
receipt_clock: finite nonnegative strictly newer now <= 1e12; invalid now returns error without mutation
measurement_clock: finite nonnegative, strictly new acquisition <= now; invalid/future/duplicate/stale acquisitions hold and cannot mutate model
fault_recovery: only a successfully fitted acquisition strictly after receipt-clock fault epoch may clear hold
silence: caller idle ticks expire accepted pose beyond0.2 seconds and latch terminal Lost
tests: blank or malformed depth preserves map
invalid receipt clock cannot mutate state
clean/faulted filtered input yield identical later estimates
comparison: clean tracker fed exactly surviving accepted depth sequence; compare every common root and trace
